title: Subway Stop A-Z
hook: Keep the subway map smaller than the whole railway world.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D railway storybook, toy trains, clean platforms and trackside scenes; visual identity: Subway Stop A-Z

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing rail network types
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Subway Stop A-Z into a network-topology song: metro/underground, intercity, sleeper/freight cars and surface crossings are mixed in the mapping, so the lyric compares network types instead of pretending all belong to one subway line.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child moves between a subway map and broader railway comparison cards, distinguishing tunnel transit from long-distance and freight stock.
